sources.title: 0DTE Index Options and Market Volatility: How Large is Their Impact?
sources.method: aggregate OMM positions from signed market-maker trades from series inception; one-minute gamma; conditional variance models
sources.reported_boundary: OMM gamma was typically positive and negatively related to conditional variance; reported maximum gamma-related increases were 3.3 percentage points annualized daily volatility and 6.4 percentage points annualized 30-minute volatility; effects were not represented as universal directional alpha.
